rules.statement: A vendor can sell property of another provided they do not act fraudulently, give vacant possession, and warrant against eviction.
rules.supporting_quote: Now although a vendor's paper title may not account for all the shares that go to make a unit he may be able to make out a good prescriptive title. In this case, there is evidence to show that the vendor has been in possession of this land for long over the prescriptive period.
